explanation.what_it_is: The effort parameter is a new control in Claude Opus 4.5 that allows you to balance the thoroughness of responses against the efficiency of token usage.
explanation.why_it_matters: This parameter gives Claude Code users more fine-grained control over the trade-off between response quality and computational cost, enabling more efficient use of resources.
how_to_use: Set the effort parameter to a lower value to reduce token usage and increase response speed, suitable for applications where brevity is more important than exhaustive detail.
Set the effort parameter to a higher value to increase response thoroughness, suitable for applications where comprehensive and detailed responses are required.

items.title: We've added client-side compaction to our Python and TypeScript SDKs,…
items.summary: We've added client-side compaction to our Python and TypeScript SDKs, automatically managing conversation context through summarization when using tool_runner.

explanation.what_it_is: Client-side compaction is a feature in the Python and TypeScript SDKs that automatically manages conversation context by summarizing it when using tool_runner.
explanation.why_it_matters: This feature reduces the amount of context that needs to be sent with each request, making conversations more efficient and reducing the risk of context overflow.
how_to_use: Use the tool_runner function in your Python or TypeScript code to automatically enable client-side compaction
Verify that conversation context is being properly summarized by checking the output of tool_runner

items.title: Search result content blocks are now generally available on Amazon Bedrock
items.summary: Search result content blocks are now generally available on Amazon Bedrock. Learn more in Search results.

explanation.what_it_is: Search result content blocks are now available for general use on the Amazon Bedrock platform, allowing developers to integrate search functionality into their applications.
explanation.why_it_matters: This update enables Claude Code users to build more comprehensive search features into their Amazon Bedrock-based projects, providing a more seamless search experience for end-users.
how_to_use: Use search result content blocks to display relevant search results within your Amazon Bedrock application
Integrate search functionality into your application's user interface using the now-available content blocks

items.title: We've launched a new documentation platform at platform.claude.com/docs
items.summary: We've launched a new documentation platform at platform.claude.com/docs. Our documentation now lives side by side with the Claude Console, providing a unified developer experience. The previous docs…

explanation.what_it_is: A new documentation platform for Claude Code, hosted at platform.claude.com/docs, where all documentation now resides alongside the Claude Console.
explanation.why_it_matters: This change streamlines the developer experience by providing a single location for both documentation and console access, making it easier to find information and work with Claude Code.
how_to_use: Access the new documentation platform at platform.claude.com/docs to find information on using Claude Code
Use the unified developer experience to switch between documentation and the Claude Console as needed

items.title: We've launched Claude in Microsoft Foundry, bringing Claude models to Azure…
items.summary: We've launched Claude in Microsoft Foundry, bringing Claude models to Azure customers with Azure billing and OAuth authentication. Access the full Messages API including extended thinking, prompt…

explanation.what_it_is: Claude models are now available in Microsoft Foundry, allowing Azure customers to access the full Messages API, including extended thinking and prompt capabilities, with Azure billing and OAuth authentication.
explanation.why_it_matters: This integration enables Azure customers to leverage Claude's capabilities with the convenience of Azure billing and authentication, streamlining the development process.
how_to_use: Access Claude models through Microsoft Foundry with Azure credentials
Utilize Azure billing for Claude model usage
Authenticate with OAuth to integrate Claude into Azure-based applications

items.title: We've launched structured outputs in public beta, providing guaranteed schema…
items.summary: We've launched structured outputs in public beta, providing guaranteed schema conformance for Claude's responses. Use JSON outputs for structured data responses or strict tool use for validated tool…

explanation.what_it_is: Structured outputs in Claude Code provide guaranteed schema conformance for responses, allowing for JSON outputs with structured data or strict tool use for validated tool interactions.
explanation.why_it_matters: This update enables Claude Code users to rely on consistent and validated response formats, simplifying data processing and integration with other tools.
how_to_use: Use JSON outputs to receive structured data responses from Claude
Enable strict tool use for validated interactions with specific tools

items.title: We announced the deprecation of the Claude Sonnet 3.7 model
items.summary: We announced the deprecation of the Claude Sonnet 3.7 model. Read more in Model deprecations.

explanation.what_it_is: The Claude Sonnet 3.7 model is being deprecated, meaning it will no longer be supported or maintained.
explanation.why_it_matters: This change affects Claude Code users who currently rely on the 3.7 model, as they will need to migrate to a newer model to ensure continued support and compatibility.
how_to_use: Review the Model deprecations documentation to understand the timeline and alternatives
Update existing code to use a supported Claude model version

items.title: We've retired the Claude Sonnet 3.5 models
items.summary: We've retired the Claude Sonnet 3.5 models. All requests to these models will now return an error.

explanation.what_it_is: The Claude Sonnet 3.5 models have been removed from the Anthropic API, resulting in an error for any requests to these models.
explanation.why_it_matters: This change affects any existing workflows or applications that rely on the Claude Sonnet 3.5 models, which will now need to be updated to use alternative models.
how_to_use: Update your API requests to use a different model version
Review and modify any dependent code or workflows to handle the error response from retired models
